metadata.description: 안창현 (Achmage) 의 Claude 스킬 모음 - image-embedded HTML 덱, 카드뉴스, 화이트보드 영상, corpus 기반 component consulting v3 + render-audit QA 등.

plugins.name: raw-5-html
plugins.description: Image-embedded HTML presentation deck architect (raw5 method): 1920x1080 HTML PPT / 카드뉴스 / keynote from a topic, 5 reused background images, text/charts stay HTML/SVG.

plugins.name: component-consulting
plugins.description: Component consultant: given a site's goal + DESIGN.md tokens, prescribes which open-source UI component to buy, how to remap it to the tokens, and where to place it. 5-axis gates-first rubric + gallery live-scan. Design.md posture: consumes.

plugins.name: insta-cardnews
plugins.description: Instagram photo card-news (카드뉴스): 1080×1440 3:4 portrait, up to 20 cards, ONE purpose-built AI image per card under a single legibility filter (wash/tone/blend/material). Inverse of raw-5-html (one dedicated photo per card, not 5 reused). Two deliverables from one build — carousel 1080×1440 PNGs + a mobile one-card-per-screen HTML viewer. 3-stage HARD-STOP workflow (plan → per-card prompts batched by 10 → build + export).

plugins.name: component-consulting-v3
plugins.description: Page-as-text component consultant with a real vendored corpus. Treats one loaded HTML page as one complete piece of writing: derives WHO reads it, WHAT genre it is, and HOW to compose it (Reader → Genre → Beats), then fills each beat from a 4,200+ open-source component corpus with actual code (uiverse, smoothui, magicui, tailark — MIT, commit-pinned, author-attributed) via deterministic retrieval. No live-scan sourcing, no model-memory stubs: every STUB is copied from a corpus code_path. Ships blocking gates (license, density floor, slop bans, prescription completeness) and emits a Render QA hand-off contract consumed by the render-audit skill. Supersedes component-consulting v1/v2. Design.md posture: consumes.

plugins.name: render-audit
plugins.description: Render-measured QA auditor for built frontend pages. Runs four layers against the RENDERED page, never just the source: RQ1 deterministic structure checks (9 items, getBoundingClientRect), RQ2 pixel-contrast measurement (canvas worst-pixel WCAG), RQ2-OBS scene observability & coverage accounting (texture-energy sd — the dual pull that stops scrim monotone escalation), RQ3 multimodal screenshot traversal with a mandatory section×scheme matrix. FULL sweep (3 widths × 2 schemes) is the default; reduced runs are legal only by explicit declaration. Findings follow audit discipline: HIGH/MED/LOW severity, evidence-not-taste, cap 15, honest Not-reviewed listing. Pairs with component-consulting-v3's Render QA hand-off contract, but audits any frontend build.
